selection_rationale: CAND-2026-001 (Latency-aware generate–validate integration) best balances operational relevance, falsifiability, and feasibility for CNSM’s Agentic-AI NetOps theme: it addresses a concrete, high-impact trade-off (safety vs end-to-end latency) supported by prior generate–validate literature, fits the short-paper scope, and its interventions/metrics are testable within the available compute/model budget. Critic feedback is actionable and repairable prior to preregistration.
unresolved_uncertainties: Risk-scoring blind spots: how selective verifier may miss adversarial or out-of-distribution fault modes.
Digital-twin / formal-checker construct validity: degree to which verifier labels reflect production device behavior across vendors/protocols.
Realistic numeric latency SLO choice (e.g., operational 95th-percentile ms target) and its feasibility with candidate validators.
Treatment of provider/API outages and their effect on measured pipeline latency and safety metrics.
Calibration and threshold-selection procedure for the selective verifier and its sensitivity to threshold choice.
required_repairs_before_preregistration: Specify numeric latency SLO(s) (e.g., explicit 95th-percentile target in milliseconds) and justify chosen values against operational requirements.
Define the risk-scoring algorithm: features, model/classifier, training/calibration data, and the preregistered threshold-selection procedure (including how thresholds will be chosen and validated).
Include adversarial and out-of-distribution test cases in preregistered sensitivity analyses to evaluate risk-scoring blind spots.
Document digital-twin / formal-checker fidelity: protocols/vendors modeled, known limitations, validation/spot-check procedure for ground-truth labels, and how verifier coverage gaps will be handled.

Predefine retry and failure-handling policies for LLM/provider outages and explicit rules for how such incidents will be treated in latency and accuracy analyses (including logging and exclusion/inclusion rules).
